Ramadan Best of 2023 Hello 2024 TikTok LIVE Assets Effect Challenge Release Notes Welcome to the Effect House beta!
Creative effects are part of what makes it so fun to create on TikTok.
To expand what’s possible with effects, we created Effect House – a platform that allows anyone to build Community Effects for TikTok.
Effect House has been in closed beta since last fall, and today we’re excited to open the beta to all creators, designers, and developers from around the world, inviting them to imagine new frontiers for TikTok’s effects universe.
Inspiring joy and creativity with Community Effects Effect creators have already inspired a world of joy, creativity, and entertainment with the effects they have made throughout the early beta for Effect House.
To date, more than 450 effect creators have published effects on TikTok, inspiring the creation of more than 1.5 billion videos and garnering over 600 billion views globally.
Through the expansion of the Effect House beta, we’re looking forward to seeing more of the world’s creative builders develop engaging and exciting effects for our global community.
Keeping safety and inclusivity at the heart of creative effects We’re focused on fostering a safe, authentic, and inclusive environment for our global community to create and engage with effects.
In addition to our Community Guidelines , effects must follow our Effect Guidelines , which outline additional policies aimed at helping everyone on TikTok feel welcome and empowered to create exactly as they are.
For instance, we don’t allow effects that promote colorism or negative stereotypes against protected groups, nor do we allow effects that depict cosmetic surgery, such as lip fillers, or encourage scrutiny of someone’s appearance.
All submitted effects will be reviewed by our Trust and Safety team to help ensure they adhere to our policies before they’re released to the broader TikTok community.
If we identify a violative effect, we will remove it and notify the effect’s creator.
While we strive to proactively identify and remove violative content, our community can also report effects they believe are not in line with our policies using the ‘Report Effect’ feature.
If we determine an effect was incorrectly approved, we will remove the effect and videos that feature it.
Or, if we see an effect being used in a way that violates our Community Guidelines, we will remove the effect and violative videos we identify that used it.
Out of an abundance of caution, some effects, such as those depicting alcohol, may be ineligible to appear in the Effect Tray as we keep the breadth of our audience top of mind.
Celebrating the Effect House community To celebrate the impact of the Effect House community and inspire future creators, we’re spotlighting effect creators who are bringing their artistry, ingenuity, and creativity to life with their effects on TikTok.

Shooting Challenge by @xyzgames999 BlockLympics Javelin by @fusedthreed Golf Olympic Master by @cloves.ar Human vs. Cheetah by @karmaismydog Soccer Goal Challenge by @neurabox.id Home Run Challenge by @deanftrh Crazy Run by @dna.stories GoalKick Pro 2 by @buddy3dmad Penalty Shooters by @duongtanar About this challenge Attention all athletes and sports enthusiasts!
We’re thrilled to invite you to participate in our sports-themed game effect challenge as we celebrate a vibrant season of sports and activities!
Show your creativity by designing a sports-inspired effect for an opportunity to win amazing cash prizes.
Don’t miss out on this exciting chance to showcase your talent and passion for sports!
What we’re looking for Create a fun and interactive game effect that falls under one of the following activities: Ball sports :
Simulate a sport with balls, such as football, basketball, volleyball, or billiards.
Throw or receive a ball to win the game!
Marksman games : Challenge users’ precision with a fun archery-inspired game where they aim for the bullseye or any target!
Track and field sports: Interactive effects that require users to race and avoid obstacles to win the game!
Tips Here are some tips to create a successful game effect: Game duration : Design your game to be completed in about 15 seconds if played correctly.
For more complex games, include a prompt or hint encouraging users to select the 60-second video option on TikTok.
Effect icon : Ensure your effect icon is clear, simple, and accurately represents your game Difficulty level: Make your game easy to play but with a medium difficulty level to win Prompts and hints : Use Text objects to inform players of the winning conditions at the beginning and display their progress or score throughout the game Winning screen : Include a winning screen with celebratory elements like ribbons and cheering sounds when the user wins Need more inspiration?
Check out these templates that are widely used for viral effects!
Champion Swimmer Champion Runner Champion Header Use the latest Effect House version Remember to update Effect House to the latest version to use our newest tool features, templates, and assets!

About this challenge TikTok and Billie Eilish present the first-ever TikTok music effect challenge— HIT ME HARD AND SOFT Effect Challenge!
Effect House is TikTok’s free effect-creation tool for Mac and PC.
When you create and publish TikTok effects in Effect House, creators around the world can use them in their videos.

Create effects inspired by Billie Eilish’s new album for a chance to win cash prizes, signed merch, and tickets to see her live.
What we’re looking for Create effects that feature songs from Billie Eilish’s new album, HIT ME HARD AND SOFT , using TikTok Sounds Library in Effect House.
Tip:
Favorite a sound from the Sounds tab on @billieeilish ‘s TikTok profile, and it will appear in your Favorites of the TikTok Sounds Library in Effect House!
Note Support for the “default sound” functionality will be gradually rolled out to all TikTok users via an upcoming app update and may not be available for all users during the challenge period.

Calling all new and advanced creators: Get perks for creating effects on Effect House when you earn Bonus Badges!
Bonus Badges are special badges that offer exclusive benefits for achieving specific publishing and engagement milestones.
These leveled badges are designed to meet you at every step of your creation journey, and celebrate you for publishing highly engaging effects.
How Bonus Badges Work Bonus Badges have five levels, each is unlocked based on the number of effects published and the number of times the effects are used by other creators in their videos.

Remember, only effects created in the Effect House desktop tool qualify for Badges.
For more information and to start tracking your badges, visit the Effect House’s Badges page .
